title: Subsistence Strategies: Foraging Overview
reason: This lecture explains the subsistence strategy of foraging, an important economic and social institution.

tasks.task: Describe the foraging strategy and its characteristics.

subtasks.text: Explain that foraging involves hunting, fishing, and gathering, with 85% of the food coming from natural resources.
